name: Bidirectional Volume Boundary Estimator
aliases: Multi-Directional Form of the Boundary Integral
Multi-directional estimation of the boundary integral
Multi-directional form of the boundary path integral
definition: A Monte Carlo estimator that samples volume boundary paths by first drawing the volume boundary vertex, then constructing two subpaths to connect it to the light source and the detector.
summary: A Monte Carlo estimator that samples volume boundary paths by first drawing the boundary vertex, then constructing symmetric source and detector subpaths to avoid costly silhouette edge searches.
